title: Are LLMs Rational Investors? A Study on Detecting and Reducing the Financial Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' scoring of financial news and events by altering the subject company to measure score variance (Anchoring Effects), correlating output scores with company market capitalization and industry sectors (Representativeness Bias), and calculating the standard deviation of event evaluations across different company contexts (Overconfidence).

Simulating financial decision-making by prompting models with 200 gain-framed and 100 loss-framed multiple-choice scenarios to select among risk-averse, risk-neutral, and risk-loving options, and translating the prompts into different languages to observe linguistic framing effects.
